# Fluid scenes for kremenmc.probe.fluid.Scenes (see fluid_ref_test.go).
scene flat overworld -9 100 -9 9 102 9
cmd fill -8 100 -8 8 100 8 stone
cmd setblock 0 101 0 water
run 60

scene drop overworld 55 98 -9 73 102 9
cmd fill 56 100 -8 72 100 8 stone
cmd fill 56 98 -8 72 98 8 stone

cmd setblock 64 100 -4 air
cmd setblock 64 101 0 water
run 60

cmd setblock 128 101 0 air
run 60
